sources.citation: SPPEL. n.d. 'Eravallan Grammatical Features' (50 WALS-style features; source/investigators V. Gnanasundaram, N. Vijayan, P. Suresh).
sources.note: Silent on stress: 15 phonology features (14 consonants, 5 vowel qualities, syllable structure '(C)(C)(C)V(C)(C)(C)(C)', 'Tone: No tones', etc.); no stress/accent feature is included.

tone.says: WALS-style phonology block (features 1-15) by the fieldworkers: 14 consonants, 5 vowel qualities, complex syllable structure (C)(C)(C)V(C)(C)(C)(C), and feature 13 'Tone' = 'No tones'. No stress, accent or intonation feature is given. This is the only explicit tone statement located for the language; the fuller treatment would be the phonology chapter of Gnanasundaram, Vijayan & Suresh 2023 (a work listed here, print only).
